UPSSSC PET Online Form 2026 – Extended - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has recently published the official notification for UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) on the official website of UPSSSC. Check More Detail on Sarkari Result For which the details for UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) Online Form 2026 has been provided on this page. Online applying process for UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 has started from 03 August 2026 & Candidate can apply till 07 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 3 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Form Correction Date : September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 185/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 95/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
